title: Intelligence as Infrastructure: How AI Is Rewiring the Economy
description: Leon Shaulov, Founder, Maplelane Capital and Alex Sacerdote, Founder, CEO and Portfolio Manager, Whale Rock Capital Management in conversation at Sohn Investment Conference 2026. Moderated by CNBC's Leslie Picker.
summary: The pitch argues that the AI revolution is fundamentally rewiring the economy by creating a powerful industry cycle centered on memory and infrastructure. It posits that companies with high exposure to memory, such as Lam Research, are undervalued due to an impending spending boom, while others like DataDog and Google are viewed as unique assets or winners in the AI space with significant upside potential. The speaker also highlights Texas Instruments and Intel as strong picks, citing tight pricing in analog semiconductors and a resurgence in Intel's foundry business, respectively.
